capabilities: Render h5-renderer fenced blocks as cards
Inherit the note's theme, width and typography
Strip scripts, remote resources and network requests
Support CSS-only interactivity such as details, tabs and hover
Insert a sample note and copy AI instructions
disambiguation: Not a web-page or HTML5 site renderer; it turns one fenced block into a static, script-free card.
extras: Manifest marks the plugin desktop-only until mobile testing; interface ships in Chinese and English only, other languages fall back to English. Render time budgets (50 ms and 500 ms) are fixed and not configurable. Installable via BRAT or manually.
motivation: Built for the blocks an AI hands you.
problem: HTML pasted into a note shows as raw code, and screenshots of layouts cannot follow the note's theme or stay selectable.

relations.evidence: Mermaid stops at flows; a screenshot cannot follow your theme.

summary: Renders h5-renderer fenced HTML blocks as theme-matching cards in the editor and reading view, with no scripts or network access.
